#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    while (std::cin >> n >> s) {
        bool inside_paren = false;
        int word_count_inside = 0;
        std::string current_word_outside = "";
        std::string longest_word_outside = "";
        bool start_new_word_inside = true;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            char ch = s[i];
            if (ch == '(') {
                inside_paren = true;
                start_new_word_inside = true;
                current_word_outside = "";
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                inside_paren = false;
                current_word_outside = "";
            } else {
                if (!inside_paren) {
                    if (ch == '_') {
                        current_word_outside = "";
                    } else {
                        current_word_outside += ch;
                    }
                    if (current_word_outside.length() > longest_word_outside.length()) {
                        longest_word_outside = current_word_outside;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (ch == '_') {
                        start_new_word_inside = true;
                    } else {
                        if (start_new_word_inside) {
                            ++word_count_inside;
                            start_new_word_inside = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        std::cout << longest_word_outside.length() << " " << word_count_inside << std::endl;
    }
    std::cout << std::flush;
    return 0;
}
